title: Call of Duty testers vote to authorize a strike 🪧
subject: activision
description:
Should game testers get a contract before Modern Warfare 4 ships? 👇

Activision Quality Assurance United-CWA, the union of Call of Duty QA testers, voted to authorize a strike after more than two years of bargaining without a first contract. Activision says it is bargaining in good faith and has offered to meet on October 21 and 22. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 launches worldwide October 23, 2026.

Sources: CWA press release (Oct 15, 2026), Kotaku (Oct 15, 2026), Aftermath (Oct 15, 2026)

scenes.text: Their union, Activision Quality Assurance United-CWA, formed in March 2024 with nearly 600 testers.
Kotaku reports it's down to just over 400 people, still without a first contract after more than two years of talks.
Wages, AI limits, contractors and disability accommodations are still open.
Activision says it's bargaining in good faith and has offered to meet on October 21 and 22.
Modern Warfare 4 launches worldwide on October 23.
